claim: Kinabalu Basin fill rests on the Borneo (Crocker) accretionary wedge and its seaward flank — upper plate of the collision system; it is a group of wedge-top/foreland depocentres.
DRU (13.5–12.5 Ma) marks post-collision uplift, major erosion and onset of Stage IV progradation in this province; DRU is distinct from BMU/Top-Crocker (~base Miocene).
